For development is best to run the application through the command as described in  Building with npm document. ng serve

## Modification of Screen in pwc-ui code

The starting point of the change is the screen. The required screen to be modified in pwc-ui comes with a path on the url which is mapped on a <<module_ file. name>>.routes.ts


```
e.g. https://cms3sit.vaservices.eu:8443/PowerCardv35/#/admin/center
```

For example the above url points to the center screen which is routes to file which leads to class. center.module CenterModule

The screen module associates with the relevant angular components:


In the above example the files represent the following functionalities:
- tests folder = unit tests
- view folder = the html and typescript files required for the screens
- vo (value object) folder = the entity component
- center.config.ts file (should be updated with more info) = configuration file
- center.module.ts file = angular module class


The view contains all files for presentation of the current module (search, detail):

The usual actions associated with each screen are:
- Search : search for results based on the user input
- Add : add new entry
- Clear : clear the results from the previous search
- Edit an entry of the results table by double-clicking on it


Each of these actions are correlated with a rest api call on the back-end (pwc-server).

In order to find which rest api call is does which action a simple technique is through developer tools of browser (right-click on the page and select the Inspect Element option).

e.g. Search in Center module corresponds to as shown in the picture below: compliance/CenterService/searchCenterService

# Modification of Screen in pwc-ui module

By adding a new field we also must update the entity object (vo), in our case file by adding the attribute name and type. center.entity.ts

Each rest call to pwc-server transfers the whole value object so in order to correctly execute the job value object must be updated with the correct attributes.

After the addition of html elements in combination with pwc-shared modules. The main components that are used by screens are part of pwc-shared module which provide custom functionality on basic angular components

<<TODO: explain more about localisation>>

e.g. pwc-toggle, pwc-input, pwc-eureka


```
CenterVO:{ "center_code": null, "grouping_code": null, "center_name": null, "network_code": null, "multi_country_option": null, "country_code": null, "country_code_alpha": null, "currency_code": null, "currency_code_alpha": null, "page": 0, "pageSize": 0 }
```

```
"centerVO":{ "center_code":"66", "grouping_code":"N", "center_name":"SIA TEST 123", "network_code":"00", "multi_country_option":"N", "country_code":"300", "country_code_alpha":"GRC", "currency_code":"978", "currency_code_alpha":"EUR" }
```

Affected Bitbucket repository: PowerCardSIA/pwc-ui


# Modification in pwc-server module


The rest api calls are done to the following request URLs:
- /compliance/CenterService/createCenterService = create new Center
- /compliance/CenterService/searchCenterService = search Center
- /compliance/CenterService/deleteCenterService = delete Center
- /compliance/CenterService/updateCenterService = edit Center


This means that the affected backend element is located in the compliance module of the pwc-server project.

Generally, to change the backend a change in the .btdesign file of the affiliated module is enough. So, in order to add a new field in the Center for example, the pwc-server/compliance/src/main/resources/compliance needs to be changed, in order to reflect the changes in the database. Find .btdesign the entity of the element you want to change and do the modified changes in the Entity and the DataTransferObject (dto).

example of the center section in compliance.btdesign /******************** Center **************************/ Entity Center { databaseTable = "Center" auditable ! optimisticLocking scaffold String center_code key length = "2"; String grouping_code databaseColumn = "grouping_code" length = "1" nullable; String center_name databaseColumn = "center_name" length = "30" nullable; - @Network fk_center_nc hint = "BaseColumn1=network_code" nullable fetch = "lazy"; String multi_country_option databaseColumn = "multi_country_option" length = "1" nullable; - @Country fk_center_ccd hint = "BaseColumn1=country_code" nullable fetch = "lazy"; String country_code_alpha databaseColumn = "country_code_alpha" length = "3" nullable; - @Currency_table fk_center_ccy hint = "BaseColumn1=currency_code" nullable fetch = "lazy"; String currency_code_alpha databaseColumn = "currency_code_alpha" length = "3" nullable; Repository CenterRepository { findByKeys; findByKey; findByCondition; findByCriteria; } } DataTransferObject CenterVO { String center_code ; String grouping_code ; String center_name ; String network_code ; String multi_country_option ; String country_code ; String country_code_alpha ; String currency_code ; String currency_code_alpha ; } Service CenterService { > @CenterRepository String createCenterService(@CenterVO centerVO); String updateCenterService(@CenterVO centerVO);

; String country_code ; String country_code_alpha ; String currency_code ; String currency_code_alpha ; } Service CenterService { > @CenterRepository String createCenterService(@CenterVO centerVO); String updateCenterService(@CenterVO centerVO); String deleteCenterService(@CenterVO centerVO); List<@CenterVO> getAllCenterService(); List<@CenterVO> searchCenterService(@CenterVO centerVO); }

After the changes are completed, the parent module (v3_31-parent  of the pwc-server project needs to be built (with the command ) for the ) mvn install code to be generated from the compliance.btdesign and the v3_31-web.war to be built.

Read carefully the document Sculptor generator!!!

Affected Bitbucket repository: PowerCardSIA/pwc-server


## Modification in pwc-db module

Locate the table from .btdesign file, in this case the Center table


```
databaseTable = "Center"
```


and then create the following scripts:
- sql scripts for changing the schema of the table based on the modifications you want to make (e.g. addition of new columns, constraints etc.)
- sql script for adding all the labels you want to use in the gui (plus the localization of those) in the table RESSOURCE_BUNDLE (the gui gets all
- the values used as labels from the database)
- bash script for applying all the above changes in the database
- bash script for performing rollback on the above changes


Add the required scripts in the pwc-db project as described in the Feature Deployment and Rollback (WIP) document.

Affected Bitbucket repository: PowerCardSIA/pwc-db
